# Ouro UI

> Designed down to the last tap and the last prop. Interactions that feel right to the humans using them. Code that's obvious to the agents building with them. Copy-in source distributed as a shadcn/ui registry on GitHub (ourostack/ouro-ui). No npm package: the shadcn CLI copies each component into your app.

## Install

In an existing Vite or Next.js app with Tailwind CSS v4 and an "@/*" path alias, run shadcn init once, with the Base UI base and without -t/--template, then add items:

```sh
npx shadcn@latest init --base base --preset nova --yes --no-monorepo
npx shadcn@latest search 'ourostack/ouro-ui#v0.4.0'      # list the items
npx shadcn@latest view 'ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog#v0.4.0'  # read one item
npx shadcn@latest add ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog#v0.4.0     # install it
```

- A new Vite app needs @tailwindcss/vite, @import "tailwindcss";, a Vite @ alias, and "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } in both tsconfig.json and tsconfig.app.json (no baseUrl on TypeScript 6) before init: shadcn reads the root file, and tsc -b builds the app one.
- --preset nova lets init run without prompts. It sets shadcn's starting theme, font and icons, which Ouro components read like any shadcn theme. The install test runs nova and vega; other presets are untested.
- A GitHub source is owner/repo#ref; an item is owner/repo/item#ref. @v0.4.0, github: and /tree/ URLs do not work.
- A release tag (#v0.4.0) installs the item and every Ouro dependency at that tag. Without a ref, items come from main, which is for contributors and can hold unreleased changes; use a release tag or @ouro.
- Components land in components/ouro/<component>/ and helpers in lib/ouro/. Ouro UI never writes to components/ui/, so do not pass --overwrite on a first install.
- Tests are optional: add <item>-tests beside the item (npx shadcn@latest add ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog#v0.4.0 ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog-tests#v0.4.0), or ouro-tests for all of them. The ouro-testing install message lists the config files to add.
- The @ouro namespace serves the newest release (the same code as #v0.4.0): add "registries": { "@ouro": "https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/r/{name}.json" } to components.json, then npx shadcn@latest add @ouro/dialog.

## Items

- `ouro-base`: Installed with every component; you don't need to add it. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the motion tokens, the press utility, the spinner keyframes, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).
- `ouro-theme`: Ouro UI's own look, as a shadcn theme for :root and .dark. Skip it to keep your app's theme.
- `ouro-lib`: Installed with every component; you don't need to add it. Shared helpers every Ouro UI component uses, in lib/ouro: cn, dev messages, the className check, announce, OuroProvider and hooks.
- `ouro-testing`: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap and emulateMedia commands, the act helper, axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.
- `button`: A button, or a link styled as one. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/button.md
- `text`: Body text in the theme's type scale and colors. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/text.md
- `heading`: A section title, `<h1>` to `<h6>`, in the theme's foreground color. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/heading.md
- `sheet`: A panel that slides in from an edge and is dragged back to dismiss: the mobile form of a dialog. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/sheet.md
- `dialog`: A dialog that presents itself for the screen: a centered dialog on wider screens and a bottom sheet you can drag away on phones (below 640px). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/dialog.md
- `confirm-dialog`: Asks the user to confirm an action, with Cancel focused first. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/confirm-dialog.md
- `field`: A labeled form control: the label, an optional description, the control and its error, wired together with ids that match between the server and the browser. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/field.md
- `fieldset`: A titled group of related fields, such as an address, rendered as a `<fieldset>` named by its legend. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/fieldset.md
- `link`: A text link that navigates through your router. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/link.md
- `text-field`: A labeled one-line text input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/text-field.md
- `text-area`: A labeled multi-line text field on the Field contract, a native `<textarea>`: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/text-area.md
- `avatar`: A person's picture, or their initials until it loads or when it fails. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/avatar.md
- `badge`: A short label for a status, category or count: "Draft", "Vegan", "3". Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/badge.md
- `alert`: An inline message in the page: something saved, something failed, something to know before going on. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/alert.md
- `separator`: A thin line in the theme's border color between groups of content, horizontal or vertical. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/separator.md
- `kbd`: A keyboard shortcut, in the reader's platform's notation: `keys={["mod", "k"]}` shows ⌘K on a Mac, iPhone or iPad and Ctrl+K elsewhere. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/kbd.md
- `toggle`: A button that stays pressed until it is pressed again, such as Bold in a text toolbar. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/toggle.md
- `toggle-group`: A row of related toggles that share one value, such as text alignment or bold, italic and underline in a toolbar. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/toggle-group.md
- `button-group`: Related buttons joined into one control, such as Previous, a page number and Next, or a split button. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/button-group.md
- `otp-field`: A one-time code entry on the Field contract: one slot per character, with focus that moves as the person types, a whole code pasted at once, and `autoComplete="one-time-code"` so phones offer the code from a text message. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/otp-field.md
- `file-field`: A labeled file input with a drop zone, on the Field contract. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/file-field.md
- `color-field`: A color on the Field contract: a swatch that opens the system color picker, next to the same color as hex text, kept in step both ways. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/color-field.md
- `ouro-lib-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests for ouro-lib, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside ouro-lib: add ouro-lib ouro-lib-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `button-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for button, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside button: add button button-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `text-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for text, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside text: add text text-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `heading-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for heading, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside heading: add heading heading-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `sheet-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for sheet, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside sheet: add sheet sheet-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `dialog-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for dialog, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside dialog: add dialog dialog-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `confirm-dialog-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for confirm-dialog, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside confirm-dialog: add confirm-dialog confirm-dialog-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.
- `field-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for field, with the test tooling as devDependencies. Add it beside field: add field field-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.

Add it beside fieldset: add fieldset fieldset-tests. It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.

It sets vitest to ^5, the version its tests are verified on; an app pinned to Vitest 4 keeps its pin by not adding the -tests items, which no component needs.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/): one page per component, with props and examples. Each page is also Markdown at https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/<item>.md, the URL each item above ends with.
- [Parts](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/parts.md): the building-block parts of Sheet, Dialog and Field, for layouts the props do not cover.
- [README](https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui#readme)
